questions.question: Explain why the gender pay gap exists and evaluate whether legislation can eliminate it.
questions.correctAnswer: The gap exists because: occupational segregation, part-time work, career breaks, glass ceiling, discrimination. Legislation has reduced but not eliminated it because laws address direct discrimination but not structural factors.

questions.question: Compare different Feminist perspectives on gender inequality.
questions.correctAnswer: Liberal: reform through law - effective but slow. Marxist: capitalism + patriarchy - need to overthrow both. Radical: patriarchy is root cause - need fundamental restructuring. Difference: women are not one group - intersectionality matters.

questions.question: Evaluate whether gender inequality has been significantly reduced in modern Britain.
questions.correctAnswer: Progress: girls outperform boys, equal pay legislation, more women in professional jobs. Remaining: 8% pay gap, glass ceiling, domestic violence, care work, under-representation. Conclusion: significant progress but full equality not achieved.

questions.correctAnswer: A grade 9 response will: present evidence for gender inequality; compare with class and ethnic inequality; consider intersectionality; conclude: gender inequality is significant but cannot be isolated from class and ethnic inequality. No single form is 'most significant' - they interact and compound each other.
